calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Dec-19-2013 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Name Change.
Dept. 514, Judge: Donald Sullivan, Clerk: Yolanda Mazariegos, CSR: Sonia Wong, #11288.
Clifford Y. Wang, Esq., appearing for Petitioners Weiling Chen and Mei Xian Chen; father and mother of minor present in court.
Petitioners sworn and examined through Cantonese Interpreter Clifford Y. Wang.
Proof of Publication on file.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.
The court grants the petition for Change of Name of minor from Ming Wei Chen to Kevin Wei Chen. Court also grants adult/mother from Mei Xian Chen to Michelle Meixian Chen.
Decrees Changing Name signed in open court.
